scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix apps/web
